headline: QA-focused roundup: Playwright WebMCP, local Copilot sandboxes, TeamCity warm agents, SDK and PR workflow changes that affect test reliability and agentic QA

top_signal.title: Playwright v1.64.0 — experimental WebMCP + runner and video features that aid flaky-test diagnosis
top_signal.summary: Playwright v1.64.0 adds experimental WebMCP (page.webmcp/frame.webmcp and CLI calls), test-runner shuffling, improved video capture (custom fps, styled action markers), locator.within(), and several APIs to reproduce and debug browser flakiness.
top_signal.why_it_matters: WebMCP lets QA test page-registered tools and agent integrations directly; shuffle and video improvements improve flaky-test detection, reproduction, and richer diagnostics in CI.

items.title: Reducing Android scope-sync overhead in Sentry Flutter (sentry_flutter 9.26.0)
items.summary: Sentry Flutter moved Android scope-sync work to a worker isolate, removed duplicate normalization and an extra byte copy, and benchmarked 27–30% processing-time reductions for scope payloads; changes are available in sentry_flutter 9.26.0+.
items.why_it_matters: Lower SDK overhead reduces instrumentation-induced noise and flakiness, giving mobile QA more accurate performance and stability signals during tests.

items.title: Purpose-built model for leaked secret detection (GitHub)
items.summary: GitHub published a fine‑tuned model for AI-based secret detection across secret scanning, push protection, and Copilot security reviews to identify credentials (including unstructured passwords) in code and agent outputs.
items.why_it_matters: QA teams can catch unstructured credentials and agent-generated leaks earlier, improving test-data hygiene and preventing sensitive data from entering test artifacts or histories.

items.title: Stacked pull requests generally available (GitHub) — stack metadata, timeline events, CLI/agent support
items.summary: GitHub made stacked pull requests generally available with persistent stack context in the UI, timeline events for stack membership, improved merge-queue behavior, and CLI/agent workflow enhancements for stacks.
items.why_it_matters: Stacked PRs enable incremental test selection and targeted CI runs per dependent change, reducing unnecessary full-pipeline runs and improving test impact analysis for multi-PR changes.

watch.title: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot now generally available
watch.summary: GitHub Copilot added local sandboxing (powered by Microsoft eXecution Container) to restrict filesystem, network, and credential access for agent-run commands in Copilot CLI, app, and VS Code Agent Host.
watch.why_it_matters: Watch this for safer local execution of test-generation and test-execution agents; sandboxing lowers risk from autonomous agents and eases adoption in regulated/test-sensitive environments.

learning.title: Introducing Warm Agents — a TeamCity plugin to keep test agents ready
learning.summary: JetBrains released the Warm Agents plugin for TeamCity to maintain a target count of idle, pre-started cloud agents per image, expose Prometheus-formatted utilization metrics, and provide REST/CLI controls to manage warm targets.
learning.why_it_matters: Read this to reduce PR test startup latency, improve CI predictability, and implement metrics-driven pre-warming for critical test images and platforms.
